entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SDK 11.0.100: SIGTERM sent to `dotnet <local-tool>` / `dotnet tool run` is not forwarded to the tool; the tool is orphaned (regression from 10.0.x, NativeAOT CLI path) #57091
  • CA2007 does not report `await foreach` over `WithCancellation(...)` without `ConfigureAwait` #57090
  • CA1508 false positive: Union switch in class gives warning #57085
  • [11.0 regression] NativeAOT crashes in ComputeConstantLookup compiling ML.NET WrappedCursor.GetGetter #57081
  • dotnetup: verify system root architecture from the dotnet executable header #57075

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0.1xx] Stabilize unrelated CI tests #57093
  • Harden container registry authentication redirects #57092
  • Fix dotnet-new template samples test and dotnet-watch .slnx sharing violation #57089
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Fix dotnet watch crash after switching target frameworks #57088
    Servicing-consider
  • Improve SDK task execution with multithreaded MSBuild #57087
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57086
  • Bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 5 updates #57084
    dependencies, github_actions
  • Escape localized restore errors in package list JSON #57083
    Servicing-consider
  • add CA2030: do not use ReferenceEquals with unrelated types #57082
  • Fix CA1517 false positive for value-type member writes #57077
  • Honor package source mapping in tool search and package completion #57076
  • Select issue triage assignees deterministically #57074

Merged

  • [wasm] Require the browser workload when CoreCLR sets WasmRunWasmOpt #56967
  • Publish dotnetup musl release candidate artifacts #57073

Updated

  • Add unsafe v2 support to GenAPI #56907
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Distinguish Copilot CLI and VS Code detection #57038
    Servicing-approved
  • Escape literal output paths before forwarding to MSBuild #56972
    breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created
  • Honor --no-update-check for built-in template availability notices #56975
  • Forward LangVersion when compiling satellite assemblies #56968
  • Add adaptive CI failure attribution skill #56746
  • Fix cancellation rollback and Run API stdin handling #56979
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56869
  • Respect IsPublishable in Web SDK publish hooks #56970
  • Enhance `dotnetup` `--no-progress` and add hookable json object progress reporting #57012
  • Unify dotnetup repository requirements and install-spec resolution #56798
  • Partition dotnet-new integration tests by class on Helix #56282
    stale
  • Integrate Roslyn analyzer skill with SDK overlay #56259
    stale
  • Use proper Registry Lookup for 64 Bit Machines in `dotnetup` #57051
  • Optimize top-level command help parsing #56267
  • dotnetup: stop Windows installer downgrades from turning into failed repairs #57016
  • [dotnet watch] Reload the project graph for the selected device and runtime identifier #56723
  • Align macOS SDK installer minimum with runtime #56915
  • Include core SDK task deps.json in NuGet packages #57041
  • Enable optimized Native AOT publish by default #57070
  • dotnetup: enumerate system installs without loading hostfxr #56935
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0.4xx #57071
    Servicing-consider
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0.1xx #57048
    Servicing-consider
  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0.3xx #57047
    Servicing-consider
  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0.1xx #57046
    Servicing-consider
  • Add CDN publishing pipeline for dnup #56844
